g.text: EXP-015c · POST-HOC DIAGNOSTIC ABLATION · simulation, no patient data

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif
fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: All scope=frac cells; four crossed conditions at every available fraction. 200 replicates per condition; 400 sites/chromosome; null depth 44x. Dotted line: alpha=0.05.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Lines connect tested fractions only. No confidence intervals estimated here; small differences are not claimed as effects.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: scope=all clonal controls are not part of this factorial view. Diagnostic, not confirmatory; no patient mosaic fraction or superiority over phased methods.
